summary: Phased implementation plan for the coupled handoff-identity and loop-guard-resume defects. Every edit target is under agent-system/extensions/**; the Stage 5 gate is planned as a lockstep verbatim twin across both engines while Defect B's asymmetry is recorded in both rather than mirrored.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan must edit two co-maintained files that are structurally separate reimplementations of each other (the base/hard orchestrate SKILL.md pair), phase them as (a) a leader phase that authors the change in one file, then (b) a follower phase that depends on the leader and copies it verbatim apart from named, enumerated differences (log prefix, self-attribution strings), then (c) a test phase that asserts the parity mechanically. Splitting the pair across phases is only safe when an automated parity assertion exists or is added — otherwise land both in one phase. Separately, when many phases touch the same large file, build the wave table from the union of content dependencies AND file-territory overlap, and state the overlap check explicitly under the table; same-wave phases must touch disjoint file sets or the 'parallel' claim is false.
